With the strength lacking in our air force. We send a message to foreign producers.
"We lack aircraft and we are willing to buy from you"
Other stuff we are buying 
Drones
Logistics vehicles (truck transport planes)
Missiles 
Signed IDRAF, IDMD[/quote]

We might have some tings that could interest the IDRAF;

[u]We have different types of helicopters as well as some larger types of aircraft from bombers to logistics/transport;[/u]
*FlyX AH-4 1C Hawk Wasp - Attack Helicopter (Based on AH-64D Apache Longbow)Cost: 61 million $(base helicopter) or 127.5 million $(munitions, training, spare parts, logistical and technical suport)
*Airgos AH-3 2B Argos Hornet - Attack Helicopter (Based on AH-1Z Viper)Cost: 31 million $(base helicopter) or 80 million $(munitions, training, spare parts, logistical and technical suport)
*Airgos MH-3EP "Meep" - Utility Helicopter (Based on UH-1N Twin Huey)Cost: 4.7 million $ (base helicopter) or 9 million $ (includes spares, systems, aditional weapons, training, and suppot)
*Airgos MMH-2B1 Barn Owl - Utility Helicopter (Based on UH-60 Black Hawk)Cost: 18.5 million $ (base helicopter) or 49 million $(includes spares, systems, full weapon sets, training, and support)
*Airheim HCH3-2C Hawk Moth - Heavy-lift cargo helicopter (Based on CH-53E Super Stallion)Cost: 24 million $ or 55 million $ with suport package (spare parts, training, logistics and support)
*Airgos HT-6C Master - Strategic airlifter (Based on C-5 Galaxy)Cost: 192 million $ or 270 million $ with suport package (spare parts, training, logistics and support)
*HT41(Cr or Re) Mob - (Cr)Military transport, (Re)Aerial refuelling (Based on C-130J Super Hercules)Cost: Cr-> 93 million $ or 150 million $ with suport package (spare parts, training, logistics and support), Re -> 95.6 million $ or 160 million $ with suport package (spare parts, training, logistics and support)

[u]We even have some drone craft:[/u]
*BRD-2 Surveyor - Surveillance drone(Inspired by RQ-4B Block 30/40)Cost: 35 million $ or 60 million$ with suport package
*MAD-4A Boomerang - Missile attack drone (Based on MQ-9A Reaper)Cost: 29 million $ or 56.5 million $ with suport package
*MAD-4B Wady-Ground attack drone (based on MQ-9B Skyguardian)Cost: 34 million $ or 65 million $ with suport package

Joust to mention some of them, tough there are more.
You can find more info and other aircraft here:
https://www.nationstates.net/nation=nordiheim/detail=factbook/id=2659283

We also make different types of missiles; AA, Anti-ship, Anti-Armor and Cruise missiles.

~Nordiheim Defence Department.

[quote=astanir;60342658]The invitation for peace talks would be viewed in a variety of ways by the various factions of the war.

The Astaniran National Forces would neglect to even acknowledge the Pantagrueli request, continuing their rapid advances against the Armed Restoration Front like nothing had happened.

The Armed Restoration front would deliberate over the issue greatly. Their lack of coherent leadership would put a thorn in their side and after much intense debate, nothing could be solidly agreed upon for now, leading them to also ignore the invitation.

The Democratic Army however would accept the invitation unanimously, citing their heavy losses and wish for peace. General Haru Arono would be flown to Teremok to engage in negotiations.

The Argossian militias, now somewhat working together thanks to the diplomatic efforts of Nordiheim would also choose to accept negotiations, but would remain skeptical of Pantagruels true intentions. Grand Chieftain Uuki-suk Makoli would represent the Hukuwy-Lukywa tribe, Chieftain Ogjokam Alisan would represent the Tshukwa tribe and high leader Ukugwaka would be sent to represent the Hgajawk tribe.

The Amaralo peoples army would be quick to accept negotiations given their very pro-pantagrueli stance. They would use this as an opportunity to bring Pantagruel over to their side and help them gain independence from the rest of Astanir, or even better take over the Astaniran government. Guoing Lokoa would be sent forth as the leader of the Amaralan Astanir movement.
